meta.title: STAR HILL Residence — Luxury amid nature, on the slopes of Bogd Uul
meta.description: STAR HILL Residence: a luxury development designed by Aedas, close to the city centre on the slopes of Bogd Uul, Ulaanbaatar. Residences of 2–5 rooms, 58–205 m², with a sports complex, children’s playground, Italian restaurant and landscaped grounds.

intro.label: Star Hill Residence
intro.heading: Luxury in the midst of nature.
intro.lede: Close to the city centre, on the slopes of Bogd Uul, Star Hill Residence brings everything a comfortable life needs together in one place — from children’s playgrounds to a sports complex.
intro.body: A space, free from all the worries of the outside world, in which to rediscover your true self.

architecture.label: International standard
architecture.heading: World-class architecture by Aedas.
architecture.lede: World-class comfort, realised through the architecture of the international practice Aedas. With global experience, Aedas is known for designs that combine nature with modern comfort, tailored to each country’s culture and climate.
architecture.quote: Star Hill Residence — the luxury project in Mongolia by Aedas, winner of the A&D Award and the Architect Master Prize, an international practice of more than 1,200 architects.

sculptural.title: Sculptural form
sculptural.caption: Stepped, layered volumes with planted terraces give each building its own silhouette against the hills.

glass.title: Reflective glass
glass.caption: Blue-tinted glazing mirrors the sky and the trees, softening the scale of the facades.

light.title: Floor-to-ceiling windows
light.caption: Large windows from floor to ceiling bring natural light straight in and create brighter, more spacious rooms.

detail.title: Roof gardens
detail.caption: Landscaped roofs and terraces carry the greenery of the hills up onto the buildings.

nature.label: Nature & surroundings
nature.heading: On the slopes of Bogd Uul.
nature.body: Clean air, forested hills and landscaped grounds of a world-standard, master-grade quality. At Star Hill Residence the landscape is the setting the architecture answers to.

experience.label: Limitless possibilities
experience.heading: Everything you need, in one place.

sports.title: Sports complex
sports.body: A fitness centre with equipment to international standards, and a sports hall for basketball, volleyball and more — the setting for a healthy, active way of life.

restaurant.title: Italian restaurant
restaurant.body: A premium Italian restaurant, for fine food in luxurious surroundings.

services.title: Resident services
services.body: Cleaning, ordering and a range of special services that make everyday life simpler and more comfortable.

playground.title: Roof gardens & playground
playground.body: Children’s play areas and planted roof gardens, with world-standard, master-grade landscaping.

overview.label: Project overview
overview.heading: At a glance.
overview.intro: Key facts from the official project brochure.

values.developer: STAR HILL Residence — a luxury residential development in Ulaanbaatar.
values.architect: Aedas (international). Winner of the A&D Award and the Architect Master Prize; more than 1,200 architects.
values.location: Close to the city centre, on the slopes of Bogd Uul. Khan-Uul District, 11th khoroo, Ulaanbaatar 14002.
values.residences: 2–5 rooms, 58–205 m², with floor-to-ceiling windows and the latest technology.
values.collections: Crystal (98 m² · 3 rooms), Diamond (177 m² · 4 rooms), Penthouse (347 m² · 6 rooms).
values.amenities: Sports complex with fitness centre and sports hall, children’s playground, Italian restaurant, roof gardens and landscaped grounds, cleaning and ordering services.
values.brands: Miele, Hörmann, ter Hürne, Marohn ThyssenKrupp, Panasonic, Porcelanosa, Kohler, LG Hausys.
values.financing: 5-year loans at 5% (TDB, over 80 m²); up to 3 years at 6% (58–205 m²); preferential loans for Crystal residences via TDB, Khan Bank and Chinggis Khaan Bank.

residences.label: Residences
residences.heading: Three collections.
residences.intro: Residences of {rooms} rooms and {area}, equipped with the latest technology and planned to a luxury standard.

crystal.subtitle: Crystal collection
crystal.body: Residences with 2–4 rooms, equipped with the most advanced technology for everyday comfort and planned to a luxury standard.

diamond.subtitle: Diamond collection
diamond.body: 3–4 rooms and 118–202 m². Well-organised rooms and floor-to-ceiling windows create brighter, more spacious living, with advanced fittings and luxurious interiors.

penthouse.subtitle: Penthouse collection
penthouse.body: Fittings and accessories that keep pace with modern progress. Natural light pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, and the luxurious interior design makes a statement of its own.

financing.label: Payment terms
financing.heading: Flexible payment options.
terms: Residences over 80 m²: a 5-year loan at 5% per year from the Trade and Development Bank.
Residences of 58–205 m² with 2–5 rooms: loans of up to 3 years at 6% per year.
Crystal residences up to 80 m²: preferential loans arranged promptly through Mongolia’s major banks — TDB, Khan Bank and Chinggis Khaan Bank.
financing.note: Terms as published in the project brochure; please confirm current conditions with the sales office.
